name: Yamada Teizaburo, survey sketch of Nakanotorishima, 1908
licence: public domain (Kokuritsu Kobunshokan / National Archives of Japan)
note: Not a chart depiction but a purported survey of the island itself, signed by the man who reported it: contour lines, four named hills and flats, transects, and marginal figures in ken. For an island that never existed this is the strongest kind of source there is — the invention drawn in detail by its inventor. Breaks the usual most-influential-depiction rule and is meant to.
